Add wispy strands of gossamer-thin fibers within this kaleidoscope container – now you have an otherworldly lantern beckoning dreamers down fantastical paths. Let us call it Celestial Vessel!

Each liquid has distinct density levels which create separate sonic resonances—while one jar echoes, the second receives whispered messages via resonance waves transmitted mid-air. As we scribble our cryptic codes upon walls made of whisper-walls between them... Listen closely & let these mystifying vessels speak tales of cosmic conspiracies hatched beyond time itself...
